title: SafeKEEPER® Forensic Evidence Drying Cabinets
meta_title: SafeKEEPER Forensic Evidence Drying Cabinets - Secure Storage & Drying
meta_description: SafeKEEPER forensic evidence drying cabinets provide secure, controlled storage and drying for sensitive forensic samples. Maintain chain of custody with tamper-resistant compartments.
meta_keywords: forensic evidence drying cabinet, forensic drying cabinet, evidence drying cabinet, forensic storage cabinet
short_description: SafeKEEPER® series forensic evidence drying cabinets are designed to store, dry or otherwise process forensic evidence in the controlled environment of a tamper-resistant compartment to maintain the chain of custody.
full_description:
SafeKEEPER® series forensic evidence drying cabinets provide cost-effective storage and containment for forensic evidence as it is dried by a constant flow of air. Air Science® ductless technology removes airborne pathogens, particulates, fumes and odors emitted by the contents. Using innovative filtration technology, the forensic evidence drying cabinet creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry.
State and Federal Crime Laboratories \ Medical Examiners and Coroners \ Law Enforcement Agencies \ Hospital Emergency Rooms \ Drug Agencies
seo_content: SafeKEEPER forensic evidence drying cabinets feature programmable humidity control, HEPA/ULPA filtration, and a variety of model sizes to accommodate different evidence processing needs. The cabinets maintain a secure, tamper-resistant environment to preserve the chain of custody for sensitive forensic samples. Available in single, dual, and quad chamber configurations, these drying cabinets are designed for use in crime labs, medical examiner offices, law enforcement facilities, and other forensic settings.

Construction & Design.Cabinet Style: Desktop, Standard, Extra Wide, Tall, Quad, Tri, Duplex

Protection & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories
